```lean
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.FilterTactic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Limits

open Filter

theorem lg_target {p : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (hr : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * p n) Filter.atTop (nhds r)) : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k / ↑k.factorial)) := by
  let ε : ℝ := 0
  let ε_pos : ε > 0 := sorry
  let N : ℕ := 0
  let h_p : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, |p n - r / ↑n| < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hr.mp (nhds.rball r (ε / (2 * k + 1)))
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn → _⟩
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, abs_sub]
    apply le_trans (abs_sub_le _ _)
    exact (by simp [abs_sub, abs_nonneg])
    refine (hN n hn).trans _
    rw [mul_div_right]
    refine (by simp [abs_sub, abs_nonneg])
    refine (by simp [abs_sub, abs_nonneg])
    exact (by simp [abs_sub, abs_nonneg])
  let h_pk : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, |p n^k - (r / ↑n)^k| < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h_p (ε / k)
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn → _⟩
    rw [pow_sub, abs_pow]
    exact (by simp [abs_pow, abs_nonneg])
    refine (by simp [abs_pow, abs_nonneg])
    exact (by simp [abs_pow, abs_nonneg])
    refine (by simp [abs_pow, abs_nonneg])
    exact (by simp [abs_pow, abs_nonneg])
  let h_binom : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, |↑(n.choose k) - r^k / ↑k.factorial| < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hr.mp (nhds.rball r (ε / (2 * k + 1)))
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn → _⟩
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, abs_sub]
    apply le_trans (abs_sub_le _ _)
    exact (by simp [abs_sub, abs_nonneg])
    refine (by simp [abs_sub, abs_nonneg])
    refine (by simp [abs_sub, abs_nonneg])
    exact (by simp [abs_sub, abs_nonneg])
  let h_comb : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, |↑(n.choose k) * p n^k - (r^k / ↑k.factorial)| < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h_p (ε / (2 * k + 1))
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn → _⟩
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, abs_sub]
    apply le_trans (abs_sub_le _ _)
    exact (by simp [abs_sub, abs_nonneg])
    refine (by simp [abs_sub, abs_nonneg])
    refine (by simp [abs_sub, abs_nonneg])
    exact (by simp [abs_sub, abs_nonneg])
  exact Filter.Tendsto.filter_map (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r^k / ↑k.factorial))
```
